description: This file defines the SimpleSqlSearchEngine class, a naive implementation of a search engine for SuiteCRM that performs simple LIKE-based searches across database tables associated with different modules. It includes methods for searching modules, filtering table structures, generating SQL queries, and interacting with database and bean factory components.

classes.name: SimpleSqlSearchEngine
classes.description: A naive search engine that uses SQL LIKE statements to perform simple text searches across module tables within SuiteCRM. It extends the SearchEngine class and provides methods for executing searches, filtering table structures, and constructing SQL queries.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across all modules and returns a SearchResults instance containing the combined results and elapsed time.

methods.name: filterTableStructure
methods.description: Filters a table's fields to include only varchar and text types relevant for search.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a table's structure, returning a name-to-type map.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and converts the encoding of the search query before execution.

methods.name: searchModule
methods.description: Executes a search within a specific module's table and returns matching record IDs.

methods.name: makeSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL SELECT statement for searching a table based on the query and fields.
